==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|uppercase}}

===Etymology===
Named for the original arrangement in [[typesetting]], where the drawer or case containing capital letters would traditionally be located above the one containing small letters.<ref>[http://books.google.com/books?id=ewSglB2f7qYC&pg=PA18&lpg=PA18&dq=capital+uppercase+typesetting+term&source=web&ots=6tr9ttWJM7&sig=XVBi9LMycbrSTaYzeK4fPI7r8ZI&hl=en&sa=X&oi=book_result&resnum=4&ct=result Glossary of Typesetting Terms], by Richard Eckersley, Charles Ellerston, Richard Hendel, Page 18</ref>

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-}}

# The [[capital letter]]s A, B, C, ... as opposed to the small letters a, b, c, ....
#: {{syn|en|majuscule|u/c|qq2=initialism}}

#: {{cot|en|mixed case}}
